annotations.title: Connect a domain the person owns

description: Connects a domain the person already owns (example.com or www.example.com) to one of their sites. Ploa sells no domains: every site has its free <address>.ploa.app, and the plan limits how many own domains connect (Free: none; Starter 1, Pro 3, Team any). Returns the DNS records the person adds where their domain's DNS is managed: a TXT that proves it's theirs, and an A record (bare domain) or CNAME (subdomain) to Ploa. Give the person the records exactly; don't change their DNS for them unless they ask. Then ploa_web_domain_check.

domain.description: The domain, like example.com or www.example.com.

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.

name: ploa_web_domain_add
